def factor_volume_confirmed_trend(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    short_trend = df_copy['close'].rolling(10).mean() / df_copy['close'].rolling(40).mean() - 1
    long_trend = df_copy['close'].rolling(20).mean() / df_copy['close'].rolling(80).mean() - 1
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy['volume'], window=20)
    weight = vol_ratio / (vol_ratio + 1)
    factor = short_trend * weight + long_trend * (1 - weight)
    factor.name = 'factor_volume_confirmed_trend'
    return factor
